criteria.finding: The ADR distinguishes contextual Markdown authority from the existing canonical claim, source, citation, projection, correction, and lifecycle systems.

The root and pilot index provide task-oriented entry, purposeful links, and a complete bounded path through project, source, claim, correction, capability, opportunity, method, projection, and media records.
The CallNYC chronology correction preserves previous wording, corrected account, reason, affected surfaces, and a non-public superseded record.
The public projection stays smaller than the Wiki and does not inherit the protected participant photograph or imply Council commissioning, endorsement, or adoption.
Documentation uses plain, precise language that joins care to structure and keeps uncertainty, collective context, and reader action visible.
